Welcome to Don Chuy's

Start with the quesatacos and a cup of consome for dipping. Tuesday is street taco day. The burrito is as big as everyone says. Feeding a table? Get the Pizza Birria.

Look for the red truck at 2440 McGilchrist St SE, at 25th. Open Monday through Friday from 9am, with covered seating out front. Or order ahead and grab it at the window.

Meet the family

Don Chuy and Agripina, making birria for Salem since 2020.

Before there was a truck, Don Chuy and Agripina cooked for friends' weddings, birthdays and quinceañeras. Some weekends that meant food for four or five hundred people. Everyone kept asking the same thing: why don't you open a restaurant?

In December 2020, with their son pushing them, they opened the red truck. “They're just really good cooks, and this is one of their dreams,” he told the Statesman Journal.

The whole family works the window. The tortillas are pressed to order, and the birria is made fresh every day. In 2024 their Taco Tuesday made the Statesman Journal's roundup of cheap tacos.
